Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.ddd.gov.in, www.govtcollegedaman.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor post in Government College Daman?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Assistant Professor post in Government College Daman is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of ₹50,000/- per month for the Assistant Professor position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks and possess NET/SET/SLET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2016. Ph.D. holders as per UGC Regulations 2009 are exempted from NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official websites: www.ddd.gov.in and www.govtcollegedaman.ac.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and submit it via post or in person.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the contract for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is on a Short Term Contract Basis for six months.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to Government College, Bhenslore - Kunta Road, Daman-396210.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
